mad_forest.name: Mad Forest
mad_forest.desc: Once a thriving haven, now a dumping ground for evil. A vampire is said to be the root of this evil, but we can find only mayhem and roast chicken.

inlaid_library.name: Inlaid Library
inlaid_library.desc: The Futile Scribe was cursed to know all and understand nothing. His endless library may gift us insight... or damnation. A mask of stone whispers endlessly within.

dairy_plant.name: Dairy Plant
dairy_plant.desc: The birthplace of Milk Magic churns with chaos. Here, it's not just blood that curdles. A secret map awaits the hero brave enough to enter this overthrown factory.

gallo_tower.name: Gallo Tower
gallo_tower.desc: An edifice of science and sorcery where horror was made manifest in the name of progress. Its many artifacts and experiments may lead us to what we seek.

cappella_magna.name: Cappella Magna
cappella_magna.desc: Conceited were they that ruled from so high yet stooped so low. This nexus of debased purity is the perfect place to find a vampire. Probably.

iguana_gallo_valletto.desc: Starts with 1 extra level. Gains 10% Growth every 5 levels (max +50%).

T04_AWAKE.name: Awake (IV)
T04_AWAKE.desc: Gives +3 Revivals. Consuming a Revival gives +10% Max Health, +1 Armor, and +5% Might, Area, Duration, and Speed.

T10_BEGINNING.name: Beginning (X)
T10_BEGINNING.desc: Listed weapons get +1 Amount. The character's main weapon and its evolution gain +3 Amount instead.

T21_BLOODY.name: Blood Astronomia (XXI)
T21_BLOODY.desc: Listed weapons also emit special damaging zones affected by Amount and Magnet. Enemies within Magnet range take damage based on Amount.

T18_ILLUSIONS.name: Boogaloo of Illusions (XVIII)
T18_ILLUSIONS.desc: Overall Area continuously changes between -25% and +25% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Area every level.

T05_CRASH.name: Chaos in the Dark Night (V)
T05_CRASH.desc: Overall projectile Speed continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% projectile Speed every level.

T15_GOLD.name: Disco of Gold (XV)
T15_GOLD.desc: Picking up coin bags from the floor triggers Gold Fever. Obtaining gold restores as many HP.
T15_GOLD.unlock: Reaching minute 31 in the Inlaid Library.

T09_DIVINE.name: Divine Bloodline (IX)
T09_DIVINE.desc: Armor also affects listed weapons' damage and reflects enemy damage. Character gains bonus damage depending on missing Health. Defeating enemies with retaliatory damage gives +0.5 Max Health.

T00_KILLER.name: Game Killer (0)
T00_KILLER.desc: Halts XP gain. Experience Gems turn into exploding projectiles. All Treasure Chests contain at least 3 items.
T00_KILLER.unlock: Defeat the final enemy in the Cappella Magna.

T01_AQUARIUS.name: Gemini (I)
T01_AQUARIUS.desc: Listed weapons come with a counterpart.

T19_FIRE.name: Heart of Fire (XIX)
T19_FIRE.desc: Listed weapon projectiles explode on impact. Light sources explode. Character explodes when damaged.

T07_IRON_BLUE.name: Iron Blue Will (VII)
T07_IRON_BLUE.desc: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces and might pass through enemies and walls.

T14_JEWELS.name: Jail of Crystal (XIV)
T14_JEWELS.desc: Listed weapon projectiles have a chance to freeze enemies.

T17_PAINTING.name: Lost & Found Painting (XVII)
T17_PAINTING.desc: Overall Duration continuously changes between -50% and +50% over 10 seconds. The character starts gaining +1% Duration every level.

T08_MAD_FOREST.name: Mad Groove (VIII)
T08_MAD_FOREST.desc: Every 2 minutes attracts all standard stage items, pickups, and light sources towards the character.
T08_MAD_FOREST.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Mad Forest.

T12_OUT_OF_TIME.name: Out of Bounds (XII)
T12_OUT_OF_TIME.desc: Freezing enemies generates explosions. Orologions are easier to find. Sorbettos could also be found.
T12_OUT_OF_TIME.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Gallo Tower.

T06_SARABANDE.name: Sarabande of Healing (VI)
T06_SARABANDE.desc: Healing is doubled. Recovering HP damages nearby enemies for the same amount.

T20_SINKING.name: Silent Old Sanctuary (XX)
T20_SINKING.desc: Gives +3 Reroll, Skip, and Banish. Gives +20% Might and -8% Cooldown for each active weapon slot left empty.
T20_SINKING.unlock: Reach minute 31 in the Dairy Plant.

T16_SLASH.name: Slash (XVI)
T16_SLASH.desc: Enables critical hits for listed weapons. Doubles overall critical damage.

T03_TRAGIC.name: Tragic Princess (III)
T03_TRAGIC.desc: The cooldown of the listed weapons reduces when moving.

T02_TWILIGHT.name: Twilight Requiem (II)
T02_TWILIGHT.desc: Listed weapon projectiles generate explosions when they expire. Explosions damage is affected by Curse.

T11_PEARLS.name: Waltz of Pearls (XI)
T11_PEARLS.desc: Listed weapon projectiles gain up to 3 bounces.

T13_WICKED.name: Wicked Season (XIII)
T13_WICKED.desc: Overall Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse are doubled at fixed intervals. The character starts gaining +1% Growth, Luck, Greed, and Curse every 2 levels.

scorched_soul.update: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon is coming this summer!
scorched_soul.effects: Increases Max Health and Might by a minuscule amount, which is multiplied by the Base XP value of the enemy that dropped it.
scorched_soul.title: Scorched Soul

sorbetto.name: Sorbetto
sorbetto.description: Temporarily emits freezing cones. Affected by player stats.
sorbetto.update: Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama is free and out now
sorbetto.effects: The player breathes ice in the faced direction for 10 seconds, freezing enemies.
sorbetto.notes: * Only found in special places and generated by Arcana XII - Out of Bounds.
sorbetto.title: Sorbetto

starry_heavens.name: Starry Heavens
starry_heavens.effects: All enemies are frozen for 10 seconds and take damage periodically, unable to damage the player. They still move towards the player.
starry_heavens.notes: * Some enemies are resistant to being frozen.
starry_heavens.title: Starry Heavens

treasure_chest.name: Treasure Chest
treasure_chest.description: Awards coins and Power ups. Dropped by strong enemies.
treasure_chest.update: There exist tales that don't exist.
treasure_chest.effects: Gives coins, and levels up or evolves weapons. A purple chest offers an Arcana instead.
treasure_chest.notes: * Drops from bosses, not from light sources. Doesn't get attracted to the player. * Only the quality of the chest is affected by Luck. * Grants an upgrade to 1, 3 or 5 owned weapons and passive items, depending on the tier of the chest. * Amount of coins gained is multiplied by Greed.
treasure_chest.title: Treasure Chest

vacuum.name: Vacuum
vacuum.description: Gathers all Experience Gems left on the ground.
vacuum.update: There exist tales that don't exist.
vacuum.effects: All Experience Gems are pulled to the player.
vacuum.notes: * Ignores all pickups. * It takes time for all gems to reach the player. * Can be "evolved" into Lavatrix Machina with an evolved Penshin Fatcha.
vacuum.title: Vacuum

weird_souls_purifier.name: Weird Souls Purifier
weird_souls_purifier.effects: Kills all enemies that are not immune to it.
weird_souls_purifier.notes: * Some enemies are resistant or immune to Weird Souls Purifier.
weird_souls_purifier.title: Weird Souls Purifier

drowner.name: Drowner
drowner.notes: * Floods the lower part of map, dealing 20 damage per tick.
drowner.title: Drowner

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.stages: Dairy Plant, The Bone Zone, Cappella Magna, Carlo Cart
stalker.title: Stalker

bat_swarm.name: Bat Swarm
bat_swarm.description: An instance of a Bat Swarm.
bat_swarm.update: There exist tales that don't exist.
bat_swarm.stages: Mad Forest, Inlaid Library, Boss Rash, and Eudaimonia Machine
bat_swarm.notes: * Has the Fixed Direction skill. * Uses sprites of Pipeestrello and Pipeestrello-2, but does not inherit their properties.
bat_swarm.title: Bat Swarm

flower_wall.name: Flower Wall
flower_wall.description: An instance of a Flower Wall.
flower_wall.update: There exist tales that don't exist.
flower_wall.notes: * Summons Flower Walls that encircle the player.
flower_wall.title: Flower Wall

ghost_swarm.name: Ghost Swarm
ghost_swarm.description: An instance of a Ghost Swarm.
ghost_swarm.update: There exist tales that don't exist.
ghost_swarm.notes: * Summons 20 ghosts that travel in a fixed direction.
ghost_swarm.title: Ghost Swarm

medusa_swarm.name: Medusa Swarm
medusa_swarm.notes: * Spawns a group of enemies that travel in a fixed direction.
medusa_swarm.title: Medusa Swarm

medusa_wall.name: Medusa Wall
medusa_wall.notes: * Summons a line of enemies that travels across the screen.
medusa_wall.title: Medusa Wall

shade_bomb.name: Shade Bomb
shade_bomb.notes: * Summons shades that chases the player and self-destructs for high damage.
shade_bomb.title: Shade Bomb

skull_swarm.name: Skull Swarm
skull_swarm.stages: Inlaid Library, The Bone Zone, Lake Foscari
skull_swarm.notes: * Spawns a group of enemies that travel in a fixed direction.
skull_swarm.title: Skull Swarm

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.stages: Dairy Plant, Laborratory, Mt.Moonspell, Lake Foscari, Abyss Foscari
swarm.title: Swarm

timed_enemy_spawn.name: Timed Enemy Spawn
timed_enemy_spawn.notes: * Summons an enemy that chases the player for a set duration.
timed_enemy_spawn.title: Timed Enemy Spawn

white_hand.name: White Hand
white_hand.notes: White Hand is not an entity. It is a sprite overlaid on top of the screen that slowly moves to the center of the screen and then sets the player's health to 0. There is no way to survive this.
white_hand.title: White Hand
